lessons.title: Lua chunks, globals, and embedded execution
lessons.intro:
Lua 5.4. Lua runs chunks that may return values to their caller. In embedded applications the host supplies globals and decides when chunks run; do not assume a browser, operating system, or package is present. Local bindings avoid accidentally sharing state through the environment. load compiles text into a function or returns an error; compiling does not execute that function. This is a language mechanism, not a recommendation to execute untrusted text.

Read each snippet, identify its effect, then complete a fragment. Examples are independent unless stated otherwise. Snippets may omit surrounding entry points and standard imports; displayed code is never executed by the tutor.

lessons.title: Multiple results, varargs, and nil holes

Lua 5.4. Lua adjusts a function call to one result except where the final expression in a list may expand. Parenthesizing a call forces one result. Assignment fills missing values with nil and discards excess values. Varargs use ...; table.pack records their exact count in n, including nil holes.
